name: Acid Burrower

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Burrower can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Earth Eruption
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Burrower burst out of the ground. All creatures within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

entries.name: Spit Acid
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against all targets in front of the Burrower within Close range. Targets the Burrower succeeds against take 2d6 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Acid Bath
entries.description: Reaction: When the Burrower takes Severe damage, all creatures within Close range are bathed in their acidic blood, taking 1d10 physical damage. This splash covers the ground within Very Close range with blood, and all creatures other than the Burrower who move through it take 1d6 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Burrow, drag away, feed, reposition
description: A horse-sized insect with digging claws and acidic blood.

name: Adult Flickerfly

entries.name: Relentless (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Never Misses
entries.description: Passive: When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target's Evasion is halved against the attack.

entries.name: Deadly Flight
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

entries.name: Wing Slash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d20 physical damage.

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take 3d8 direct physical damage.

entries.name: Mind Dance
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

entries.name: Hallucinatory Breath
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or become overwhelmed by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take 3d8+3 direct magic damage.

entries.name: Uncanny Reflexes
entries.description: Reaction: When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to take half damage.

motives_tactics: Collect shiny things, hunt, nest, swoop
description: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.

name: Ahuizotl

entries.name: Aquatic Attacker
entries.description: Passive: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Tail Swat
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Drag and Bag
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily Restrain them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets Restrained in this way.

motives_tactics: Ambush, drown, restrain
description: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.

name: Apprentice Assassin

entries.name: Minion (6)
entries.description: Passive: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Thrown Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Act reckless, kill, prove their worth, show off
description: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.

name: Arch-Necromancer

entries.name: Necrotic Blast
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+6) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d12+8 magic damage.

entries.name: Dance of Death
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

entries.name: Beam of Decay
entries.description: Action: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

entries.name: Open the Gates of Death
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

entries.name: Not Today, My Dears
entries.description: Reaction: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

entries.name: Your Life is Mine
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

motives_tactics: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect
description: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.

name: Archer Guard

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Hobbling Shot
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have disadvantage on Agility Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.

motives_tactics: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down
description: A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the settlement's colors.

name: Archer Squadron

entries.name: Horde (1d6+3)
entries.description: Passive: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d6+3 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 2 members of the horde (2/HP).

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Focused Volley
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take 1d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Suppressing Fire
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d6+3 physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

motives_tactics: Stick together, survive, volley fire
description: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.

name: Archmage

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Orbiting Aegis
entries.description: Passive: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

entries.name: Archmage's Greatstaff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d10 magic damage.

entries.name: Force Salvo
entries.description: Action: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

entries.name: Fireball
entries.description: Action: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

motives_tactics: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power
description: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

name: Assassin Poisoner

entries.name: Grindeloth Venom
entries.description: Passive: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

entries.name: Out of Nowhere
entries.description: Passive: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

entries.name: Poisoned Throwing Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Fumigation
entries.description: Action: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

motives_tactics: Anticipate, get paid, kill, taint food and water
description: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.

name: Atototl

entries.name: Wind Lord
entries.description: Passive: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

entries.name: Stone of Omens
entries.description: Passive: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

entries.name: Talons
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Archer's Bane
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

motives_tactics: Avoid, escape, misdirect
description: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.

name: Banshee

entries.name: Specter
entries.description: Passive: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Fingernails
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+1 magic damage.

entries.name: Scare Tactic
entries.description: Action: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

entries.name: Wail of Despair
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

motives_tactics: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies
description: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.

name: Basilisk

entries.name: Jaws & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Petrify
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already Stiff, they become Petrified. While Stiff, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

entries.name: CRONCH!
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

motives_tactics: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait
description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.

name: Battle Box

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Randomized Tactics
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The Box uses the corresponding move:
  1. Mana Beam: The Box fires a searing beam. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 magic damage.
  2. Fire Jets: The Box shoots into the air, spinning and releasing jets of flame. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 2d8 physical damage.
  3. Trample: The Box rockets around erratically. Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 1d6+5 physical damage and are Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.
  4. Shocking Gas: The Box sprays out a silver gas sparking with lightning. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress.
  5. Stunning Clap: The Box leaps and their sides clap, creating a concussive boom. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until the cube is defeated.
  6. Psionic Whine: The Box releases a cluster of mechanical bees whose buzz rattles mortal minds. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 2d4+9 direct magic damage.

entries.name: Overcharge
entries.description: Reaction: Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can mark a Stress to add a d6 to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Death Quake
entries.description: Reaction: When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 2d8+1 magic damage.

motives_tactics: Change tactics, trample foes, wait in disguise
description: A cube-shaped construct with a different rune on each of their six sides.

name: Bear

entries.name: Overwhelming Force
entries.description: Passive: Targets who mark HP from the Bear's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage and the target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Bear makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Climb, defend territory, pummel, track
description: A large bear with thick fur and powerful claws.

name: Berserker Alpha

entries.name: Pack Fury
entries.description: Passive: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

entries.name: Tooth & Claw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Bark at the Moon
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

entries.name: Berserker Rage
entries.description: Reaction: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_tactics: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies
description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

name: Berserker Initiate

entries.name: Pack Fury
entries.description: Passive: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

entries.name: Tooth & Claw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Berserker Rage
entries.description: Reaction: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_tactics: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon
description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

name: Bladed Guard

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries.description: Passive: A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the Guard must succeed on an Agility Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within Melee range of another guard in the line, the Difficulty increases by the total number of guards in the line.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Detain
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they break free with a successful attack, Finesse Roll, or Strength Roll.

motives_tactics: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down
description: An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the settlement's colors.

name: Brawny Zombie

entries.name: Slow
entries.description: Passive: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d12+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Rend Asunder
entries.description: Action: Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has Restrained. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

entries.name: Rip and Tear
entries.description: Reaction: When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

motives_tactics: Crush, destroy, hurl debris, slam
description: A large corpse, decay-bloated and angry.

name: Bugboar

entries.name: Surprise!
entries.description: Passive: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d8 damage.

entries.name: Spiked Mace
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Brutal
entries.description: Reaction: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to deal an extra 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Warheart
entries.description: Reaction: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can spend a Fear to negate it.

motives_tactics: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things
description: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.

name: Catrin

entries.name: Attracted to Wealth
entries.description: Passive: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

entries.name: Spirit Flame
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d8+5 magic damage.

entries.name: The Weight of Opulence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

entries.name: Expensive Failure
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

motives_tactics: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything
description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

name: Cave Ogre

entries.name: Ramp Up
entries.description: Passive: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Ogre. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

entries.name: Bone Breaker
entries.description: Passive: The Ogre's attacks deal direct damage.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Hail of Boulders
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to pick up heavy objects and throw them at all targets in front of the Ogre within Far range. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Ogre succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Rampaging Fury
entries.description: Reaction: When the Ogre marks 2 or more HP, they can rampage. Move the Ogre to a point within Close range and deal 2d6+3 direct physical damage to all targets in their path.

motives_tactics: Bite off heads, feast, rip limbs, stomp, throw enemies
description: A massive humanoid who sees all sapient life as food.

name: Centaur Warden

entries.name: Flanking Maneuver
entries.description: Passive: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

entries.name: Recurved Bow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Eye of the Sage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

entries.name: Trample
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Quick Volley
entries.description: Reaction: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

motives_tactics: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders
description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.

name: Cephilith Abomination

entries.name: Toxic Skin
entries.description: Passive: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

entries.name: Meaty Fists
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Bear Hug
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

entries.name: Crunch!
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

entries.name: Tongue Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

entries.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
entries.description: Reaction: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

motives_tactics: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab
description: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.

name: Cephilith Hatchling

entries.name: Minion (12)
entries.description: Passive: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Barbed Suckers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 9 physical damage.

entries.name: Comatize
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle
description: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.

name: Cephilith Novitiate

entries.name: Minion (12)
entries.description: Passive: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Eldritch Might
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 12 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Sacrifice Self
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

motives_tactics: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge
description: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.

name: Cephilith Priest

entries.name: Psychic Strike
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+10 magic damage.

entries.name: Psychic Blast
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

entries.name: Cerebral Incursion
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target's ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

entries.name: Telekinetic Grasp
entries.description: Reaction: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

motives_tactics: Break the unbelievers' minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan's arrival, sing its praises
description: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.

name: Cephilith Titan

entries.name: Relentless (X)
entries.description: Passive: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you you can spend a Fear.

entries.name: Merely a Projection
entries.description: Passive: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating its true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

entries.name: Pseudoclaw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d8+10 magic damage.

entries.name: Psychic Scream
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Summon Worshippers
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

entries.name: "It's Here…"
entries.description: Evolution: When the Titan has marked half its HP, they manifests in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the "Merely a Projection" feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan's standard attack must mark an additional HP.

motives_tactics: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos
description: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.

name: Chaos Skull

entries.name: Levitation
entries.description: Passive: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can't be Restrained.

entries.name: Wards
entries.description: Passive: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

entries.name: Energy Blast
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Magic Burst
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Siphon Magic
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

motives_tactics: Cackle, consume magic, serve creator
description: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.

name: Chicken-Foot Hut

entries.name: Fast
entries.description: Passive: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

entries.name: Clawed Feed
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

entries.name: Pin
entries.description: Reaction: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

motives_tactics: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample
description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

name: Chimera

entries.name: Rending Jaws
entries.description: Passive: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d12 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Claw
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

entries.name: Breath of Fire
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

entries.name: Serpent Strike
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle
description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.

name: Cipactli

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Attack
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d8+12 physical damage.

entries.name: Many Mouths
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

entries.name: Frenzied Feeding
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

entries.name: Quaking Footfalls
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Lifeblooded
entries.description: Reaction: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

entries.name: Verdant Explosion
entries.description: Reaction: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

motives_tactics: Consume, reshape the land, trample
description: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.

name: Cloud Titan

entries.name: Bejeweled Blade
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d6+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

entries.name: Mist Weaver
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

entries.name: Nebulous Transformation
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

entries.name: Unleash the Menagerie
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

entries.name: Wind Worker
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

entries.name: Double or Nothing
entries.description: Reaction: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don't gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

motives_tactics: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager
description: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.

name: Common Ruffian

entries.name: Improvised Weapon
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1d8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Survival Instinct
entries.description: Reaction: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Do violence, seek security and survival
description: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.

name: Conscript

entries.name: Minion (6)
entries.description: Passive: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Spears
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 6 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Follow orders, gang up, survive
description: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.

name: Construct

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Construct can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Weak Structure
entries.description: Passive: When the Construct marks HP from physical damage, they must mark an additional HP.

entries.name: Fist Slam
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d20 physical damage.

entries.name: Trample
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in the Construct's path when they move. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d8 physical damage.

entries.name: Overload
entries.description: Reaction: Before rolling damage for the Construct's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the spotlight again.

entries.name: Death Quake
entries.description: Reaction: When the Construct marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d12+2 magic damage.

motives_tactics: Destroy environment, serve creator, smash target, trample groups
description: A roughly humanoid being of stone and steel, assembled and animated by magic.

name: Courtesan

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Searing Glance
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons
description: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

name: Courtier

entries.name: Daggers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Mockery
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to say something mocking and force a target within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (14) to see if they can save face. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is Vulnerable until the scene ends.

entries.name: Scapegoat
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Courtier convinces a crowd or prominent individual that the target is the cause of their current conflict or misfortune.

motives_tactics: Discredit, gain favor, maneuver, scheme
description: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

name: Crimson Lepus

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: "Awww…"
entries.description: Passive: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Leaping Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d20 physical damage.

entries.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.description: Reaction: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

entries.name: "Run Away!"
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

motives_tactics: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around
description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

name: Cryptimoth

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Psychic Screech
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

entries.name: Shadow Swarm
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

entries.name: Paranoia Glare
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

motives_tactics: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows
description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

name: Cult Adept

entries.name: Rune-Covered Rod
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Enervating Blast
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Shroud of the Fallen
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

entries.name: Shadow Shackles
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

entries.name: Fear Is Fuel
entries.description: Reaction: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

motives_tactics: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge
description: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.

name: Cult Fang

entries.name: Shadow's Embrace
entries.description: Passive: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

entries.name: Long Knife
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Pick Off the Straggler
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks
description: A professional killer-turned-cultist.

name: Cult Initiate

entries.name: Minion (6)
entries.description: Passive: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Ritual Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge
description: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.

name: Cursed Merfolk

entries.name: Fish-Tailed
entries.description: Passive: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

entries.name: Gang Up
entries.description: Passive: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

entries.name: Chained Trident
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d6 physical damage.

entries.name: "Get Over Here!"
entries.description: Reaction: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

motives_tactics: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage
description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

name: Darkweave Crawler

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2 physical damage.

entries.name: Skin-Crawling
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Darkweave Venom
entries.description: Reaction: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

motives_tactics: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening
description: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.

name: Darkweave Queen

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Spider Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d12+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Den Mother
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

entries.name: Quicker Than She Looks
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

entries.name: Darkfang Envenomation
entries.description: Reaction: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

motives_tactics: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces
description: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.

name: Darkweave Spinner

entries.name: Fange
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

entries.name: Shadow Fang
entries.description: Reaction: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

motives_tactics: Bite, stick to the darkness
description: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings

entries.name: Horde (1d4)
entries.description: Passive: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 8 members of the horde (8/HP).

entries.name: Nibble
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8 physical damage.

entries.name: "Get 'em Off , Get 'em Off !"
entries.description: Reaction: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a d6 when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes
description: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.

name: Deep Dweller

entries.name: Teeth & Tentacle
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 3d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Psychic Blast
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

entries.name: Brain Drain
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

entries.name: Call of the Deep
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

entries.name: Mucosal Contamination
entries.description: Action: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

motives_tactics: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins
description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

name: Deeproot Defender

entries.name: Vines
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Ground Slam
entries.description: Action: Slam the ground, knocking all targets within Very Close range back to Far range. Each target knocked back by this must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Grab and Drag
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to pull them into Melee range, deal 1d6+2 physical damage, and Restrain them until the Defender takes Severe damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, grab, protect, pummel
description: A burly vegetable-person with grasping vines.

name: Demon of Avarice

entries.name: Money Talks
entries.description: Passive: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon's standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.

entries.name: Numbers Must Go Up
entries.description: Passive: Add a bonus to the Demon's attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.

entries.name: Hungry Maw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+5 magic damage.

entries.name: Money is Time
entries.description: Action: Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear) to spotlight 1d4+1 allies.

motives_tactics: Consume, fuel greed, sow dissent
description: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.

name: Demon of Despair

entries.name: Depths of Despair
entries.description: Passive: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

entries.name: Miasma Bolt
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d6+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

entries.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Make fear contagious, stick to the shadows, undermine resolve
description: A cloaked one-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.

name: Demon of Hubris

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Double or Nothing
entries.description: Passive: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

entries.name: Perfect Spear
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Unparalleled Skill
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon's standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

entries.name: The Root of Villainy
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

entries.name: You Pale in Comparison
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Condescend, declare premature victory, prove superiority
description: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.

name: Demon of Jealousy

entries.name: Unprotected Mind
entries.description: Passive: The Demon's standard attack deals direct damage.

entries.name: Psychic Assault
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d8+3 magic damage.

entries.name: My Turn
entries.description: Reaction: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

entries.name: Rivalry
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

entries.name: What's Yours Is Mine
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC takes severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or of their choice from the target's inventory.

motives_tactics: Join in on others' success, take what belongs to others, hold grudges
description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.

name: Demon of Wrath

entries.name: Anger Unrelenting
entries.description: Passive: The Demon's attacks deal direct damage.

entries.name: Fists
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+1 magic damage.

entries.name: Battle Lust
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.

entries.name: Retaliation
entries.description: Reaction: When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

entries.name: Blood and Souls
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 6). Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon 1d4 Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

motives_tactics: Fuel anger, impress rivals, wreak havoc
description: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.

name: Demon Lord Berzug

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Abyssal Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Chaos Lash
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Gaze into the Abyss
entries.description:
Action: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result):
  • 1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.
  • 3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll.
  • 5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

entries.name: Crushing Strike
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC marks HP from Berzug's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You you can spend a Fear.

entries.name: Horrifying
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Destroy goodness, sow chaos, unseat rivals
description: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent's tail, a lizard's hind legs, a crab's claw arms, and a two-faced wolf's head.

name: Demonic Hound Pack

entries.name: Horde (2d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 1 member of the horde (1/HP).

entries.name: Claws and Fangs
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Dreadhowl
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters
description: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.

name: Dire Bat

entries.name: Flying
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

entries.name: Claws and Teeth
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+7 physical damage.

entries.name: Screech
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.description: Reaction: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Dive-bomb, hide, protect leader
description: A winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

name: Dire Pangolati

entries.name: Armor Eater
entries.description: Passive: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

entries.name: Tail Slash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Blade Spin
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 physical damage.

entries.name: Blade Fling
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals 2d6+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Keratin Scales
entries.description: Reaction: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

motives_tactics: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger
description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

name: Dire Wolf

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: Passive: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Hobbling Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 direct physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.

motives_tactics: Defend territory, harry, protect pack, surround, trail
description: A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.

name: Doppelhound

entries.name: Blink Beast
entries.description: Passive: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

entries.name: Barbed Tail Whip
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive
description: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.

name: Dragon Knight

entries.name: High Ground
entries.description: Passive: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

entries.name: Lance
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Leaping Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

entries.name: Comeback
entries.description: Reaction: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

motives_tactics: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above
description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

name: Dragon Mother Mitera

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

entries.name: Diamond Hide
entries.description: Passive: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. It ticks down from Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

entries.name: Bite & Slash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d10+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Elemental Breath
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice:
  1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP.
  2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target.
  3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP.
  4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rollsuntil they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition.
  5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it.
  6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rollsthat rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature.
  7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

entries.name: Tail Swipe
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Fearsome
entries.description: Reaction: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Seven-Headed
entries.description: Reaction: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the "Elemental Breath" option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see "Diamond Hide").

motives_tactics: Birth destruction, control the battlefield, fly, repel invaders, use all available options
description: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.

name: Drake

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Claws & Teeth
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Guard Dog
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

motives_tactics: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first
description: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.

name: Dryad

entries.name: Deadfall Shortbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d10+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Bramble Patch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or take more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

entries.name: Grow Saplings
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

entries.name: We Are All One
entries.description: Reaction: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally's life force is returned to the forest.

motives_tactics: Camouflage, drive out, preserve the forest
description: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.

name: Dullahan

entries.name: Specter
entries.description: Passive: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Spectral Mount
entries.description: Passive: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

entries.name: Spine Whip
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d10+1 magic damage.

entries.name: Bone Whip Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

entries.name: Death Glare
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

motives_tactics: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves
description: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.

name: Electric Eels

entries.name: Horde (2d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 2 members of the horde (2/HP).

entries.name: Shocking Bite
