entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Paralyzing Shock
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

motives_tactics: Avoid larger predators, shock prey, tear apart
description: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.

name: Elemental Spark

entries.name: Minion (9)
entries.description: Passive: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Burst of Fire
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 5 magic damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Blast, consume, gain mass
description: A blazing mote of elemental fire.

name: Elephant

entries.name: Feet & Tusks
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12 physical damage.

entries.name: Trample
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Toss
entries.description: Reaction: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

motives_tactics: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize
description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

name: Elite Soldier

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Reinforce
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

entries.name: Vassal's Loyalty
entries.description: Reaction: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

motives_tactics: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances
description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.

name: Elk

entries.name: Headbutt
entries.description: Passive: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals 1d12+2 physical damage instead of its standard damage.

entries.name: Antlers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Bolt
entries.description: Reaction: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

motives_tactics: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger
description: A large deer.

name: Entombed Cat Beast

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Bloody Strike
entries.description: Passive: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

entries.name: Razor Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Screeching Caterwaul
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

entries.name: I Alone
entries.description: Reaction: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and you can spend a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

entries.name: Vicious Reprisal
entries.description: Reaction: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

motives_tactics: Rush attack, shred, terrify
description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.

name: Entombed Elite Guard

entries.name: Battle Formation
entries.description: Passive: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

entries.name: Curved Blade
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Javelin
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one
description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

name: Entombed Empress

entries.name: Empty Husk
entries.description: Passive: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

entries.name: Missing Organs
entries.description: Passive: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

entries.name: Swipe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Grasping Chains
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

entries.name: Deathless Obedience
entries.description: Action: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

entries.name: Accursed Caress
entries.description: Reaction: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

entries.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
entries.description: Reaction: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Command inferiors, curse the invaders
description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

name: Entombed Necropriest

entries.name: Death Bolt
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Invigorate
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

entries.name: Last Grasp
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and Restrain them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target Restrained in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Chill Touch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark 1d4 Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon
description: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.

name: Entombed Skin Beetles

entries.name: Horde (2d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 5 members of the horde (5/HP).

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Passive: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Pincers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Omophagous
entries.description: Action: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

motives_tactics: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing
description: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.

name: Entombed Stonemason

entries.name: Minion (5)
entries.description: Passive: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Hammer and Chisel
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: The Work Never Ends
entries.description: Reaction: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

motives_tactics: stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress
description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.

name: Failed Experiment

entries.name: Warped Fortitude
entries.description: Passive: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description: Passive: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.

entries.name: Bite and Claw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Lurching Lunge
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.

motives_tactics: Devour, hunt, track
description: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.

name: Falcon

entries.name: Nimble Flyer
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

entries.name: Talons
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Dive Bomb
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

motives_tactics: Circle, clutch, dive, spy
description: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.

name: Fallen Shock Troop

entries.name: Minion (12)
entries.description: Passive: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Aura of Doom
entries.description: Passive: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

entries.name: Cursed Axe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 12 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Crush, dominate, earn relief, punish
description: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.

name: Fallen Sorcerer

entries.name: Corrupted Staff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d6+10 magic damage.

entries.name: Conflagration
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

entries.name: Nightmare Tableau
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

entries.name: Slippery
entries.description: Reaction: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

entries.name: Shackles of Guilt
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

motives_tactics: Acquire, dishearten, dominate, torment
description: Warped mage bound by the bargains they made in life.

name: Fallen Warlord: Realm-Breaker

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Firespite Plate Armor
entries.description: Passive: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

entries.name: Barbed Whip
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d8+7 physical damage.

entries.name: Tormenting Lash
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

entries.name: All-Consuming Rage
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown(Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

entries.name: Doombringer
entries.description: Reaction: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

entries.name: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
entries.description: Reaction: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak
description: A fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.

name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Faltering Armor
entries.description: Passive: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

entries.name: Heart-Shattering Sword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+13 physical damage.

entries.name: Shattering Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

entries.name: Endless Legions
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

entries.name: Circle of Defilement
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Doombringer
entries.description: Reaction: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

motives_tactics: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost
description: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.

name: Fellmounted Shadow King

entries.name: Fellmount
entries.description: Passive: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he's knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

entries.name: Light and Shadow
entries.description: Passive: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

entries.name: Relic Hunter
entries.description: Passive: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

entries.name: Cursed Lance
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 3d10+6 magic damage.

entries.name: Hellsong
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King's mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can't lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

entries.name: Air Support
entries.description: Reaction: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

motives_tactics: Find magic items, inspire fear, patrol skies
description: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

name: Fire Titan

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Masterwork Armor
entries.description: Passive: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Passive: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Hurl Rock
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

entries.name: Skull Splitter
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

entries.name: Blazing Heart
entries.description: Reaction: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

motives_tactics: Act valorously, make war, think tactically
description: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.

name: Fire Titan Warlord

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Colossus Crafter
entries.description: Passive: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

entries.name: Maul
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+6) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d10+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Release the Hounds
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

entries.name: Spinning Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and you can spend a Fear.

entries.name: Ground-Breaking
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

motives_tactics: Compete against rivals, conquer the weak, craft colossal war machines
description: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.

name: Flock of Feather Fiends

entries.name: Horde (1d6+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead. Each HP stands for 4 members of the horde (4/HP).

entries.name: Peck and Claw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Maddening Cacophony
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

motives_tactics: incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes
description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

name: Fowlbear

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Goose Teeth & Bear Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

entries.name: Dread Honk
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become Vulnerable until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

motives_tactics: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs
description: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.

name: Frost Titan

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Dual Axes
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: War Horn
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

entries.name: Bull Rush
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

entries.name: Cleaving Strike
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

entries.name: Trophy Hunter
entries.description: Reaction: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

motives_tactics: Claim trophies, raid and pillage, test mettle
description: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

name: Fungispunj Sporeling

entries.name: Minion (6)
entries.description: Passive: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Neuro Spore
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4 magic damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Form Up
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

motives_tactics: Avoid violence, spray attackers
description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

name: Fungispunj Sporophore

entries.name: Spongy Fist
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Reanimator
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

entries.name: Colony
entries.description: Action: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

entries.name: Mind Meld
entries.description: Reaction: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

motives_tactics: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores
description: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.

name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Piercing Bite
entries.description: Passive: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

entries.name: Crushing Jaws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+7 physical damage.

entries.name: Tail Bash
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

entries.name: Gigaton Splash
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Steam Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

motives_tactics: Acquire riches, capsize trading vessels, lie in wait, use the waves as cover
description: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.

name: Gargantuan War Machine

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Awesome Size
entries.description: Passive: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

entries.name: Fists of Iron
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Rocket Punch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

entries.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

entries.name: Supercharged
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine's chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

motives_tactics: Crush, destroy
description: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.

name: Gargoyle

entries.name: Unliving
entries.description: Passive: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

entries.name: Stone Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Swooping Strike
entries.description: Action: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

entries.name: Petrifying Slash
entries.description: Reaction: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable. If the target is already Vulnerable, they become Restrained. If the target is already Vulnerable and Restrained, they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

motives_tactics: Hide in plain sight, overwatch, swoop down
description: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.

name: Ghastly Legion

entries.name: Horde (2d6+5)
entries.description: Passive: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead. Each HP stands for 10 members of the horde (10/HP).

entries.name: Necroplasmic
entries.description: Passive: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

entries.name: Spectral Armaments
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d6+10 magic damage.

entries.name: Final Act
entries.description: Reaction: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

motives_tactics: Overwhelm, serve, swarm
description: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.

name: Giant Beastmaster

entries.name: Two as One
entries.description: Passive: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Pinning Strike
entries.description: Action: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can mark a Stress to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.

entries.name: Deadly Companion
entries.description: Action: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster's control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

motives_tactics: Command, make a living, maneuver, pin down, protect companion animals
description: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.

name: Giant Brawler

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Battering Ram
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

entries.name: Bloody Reprisal
entries.description: Reaction: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Make a living, overwhelm, slam, topple
description: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.

name: Giant Eagle

entries.name: Flight
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

entries.name: Claws and Beak
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Deadly Dive
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

entries.name: Take Off
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle's massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts them to the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

entries.name: Deadly Drop
entries.description: Action: While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn't prevented during the PCs' next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

motives_tactics: Hunt prey, stay mobile, strike decisively
description: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.

name: Giant Mosquitoes

entries.name: Horde (1d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 5 members of the horde (5/HP).

entries.name: Flying
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

entries.name: Proboscis
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
entries.description: Reaction: When the Mosquitoes' attack causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to force the target to mark an additional HP.

motives_tactics: Fly away, harass, steal blood
description: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.

name: Giant Octopus

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Armed and Dangerous
entries.description: Passive: When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

entries.name: Arm Whip
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Grapple
entries.description: Action: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

entries.name: Crush
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to deal 3d8 direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

motives_tactics: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey
description: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

name: Giant Rat

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Rats within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Burrow, hunger, scavenge, wear down
description: A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival.

name: Giant Recruit

entries.name: Minion (7)
entries.description: Passive: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 5 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Batter, make a living, overwhelm, terrify
description: A giant fighter undergoing borrowed armor.

name: Giant Scorpion

entries.name: Pincers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

entries.name: Venomous Stinger
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to deal 1d4+4 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Ambush, feed, grapple, poison
description: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.

name: Glass Snake

entries.name: Armor-Shredding Shards
entries.description: Passive: After a successful attack against the Snake within Melee range, the attacker must mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an HP.

entries.name: Glass Fangs
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Spinning Serpent
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Snake succeeds against take 1d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Spitter
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to introduce a 6 Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the spotlight, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within Far range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d4 physical damage. The Snake can take the spotlight a second time this GM turn.

motives_tactics: Climb, feed, keep distance, scare
description: A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard trail wherever they go.

name: Gobstalker

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
entries.description: Passive: The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

entries.name: Mouth Tentacles
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Tentacle Rays
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or spend a Fear to choose instead:
  1. Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the targetWhile Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition.
  2. Corrode. The target takes 2d8 magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage.
  3. Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount.
  4. Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16).
  5. Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming Vulnerable and Restrained until they mark 2 Stress.
  6. Sear. The target takes 2d8 direct magic damage.
  7. Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16).
  8. Slow. The target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries.description: Reaction: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. entries.description: Reaction: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Rockslide
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries all the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. entries.name: Momentum

entries.name: High Tide

name: Hive Walker

entries.name: Rotting Fist
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Blood Honey
entries.description: Action: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

entries.name: Bee-Ruption
entries.description: Reaction: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

motives_tactics: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive
description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.

name: Huge Green Ooze

entries.name: Slow
entries.description: Passive: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

entries.name: Acidic Form
entries.description: Passive: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

entries.name: Ooze Appendage
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+1 magic damage.

entries.name: Envelop
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

entries.name: Split
entries.description: Reaction: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

motives_tactics: Camouflage, creep up, envelop, multiply
description: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.

name: Hydra

entries.name: Many-Headed Menace
entries.description: Passive: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

entries.name: Relentless (X)
entries.description: Passive: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Action: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

entries.name: Terrifying Chorus
entries.description: Action: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

entries.name: Magical Weakness
entries.description: Reaction: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

motives_tactics: Devour, regenerate, terrify
description: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'-Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Chomp
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 6 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

motives_tactics: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories
description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

name: Jagged Knife Bandit

entries.name: Climber
entries.description: Passive: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

entries.name: From Above
entries.description: Passive: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 1d10+1 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Daggers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Escape, profit, steal, throw smoke
description: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.

name: Jagged Knife Hexer

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries.description: Action: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily Curse them. While the target is Cursed, you can mark a Stress so that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

entries.name: Chaotic Flux
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+3 magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

motives_tactics: Command, hex, profit
description: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.

name: Jagged Knife Kneebreaker

entries.name: I've Got 'Em
entries.description: Passive: Creatures Restrained by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Hold Them Down
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is Restrained and Vulnerable. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

motives_tactics: Grapple, intimidate, profit, steal
description: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.

name: Jagged Knife Lackey

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Daggers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Escape, profit, throw smoke
description: A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves.

name: Jagged Knife Lieutenant

entries.name: Javelin
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Tactician
entries.description: Action: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, mark a Stress to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

entries.name: More Where That Came From
entries.description: Action: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

entries.name: Coup de Grace
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+12 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Bully, command, profit, reinforce
description: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.

name: Jagged Knife Shadow

entries.name: Backstab
entries.description: Passive: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal 1d6+6 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Daggers
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Cloaked
entries.description: Action: Become Hidden until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, conceal, divide, profit
description: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.

name: Jagged Knife Sniper

entries.name: Unseen Strike
entries.description: Passive: If the Sniper is Hidden when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal 1d10+4 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, hide, profit, reposition
description: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.

name: Juvenile Flickerfly

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Peerless Accuracy
entries.description: Passive: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

entries.name: Wing Slash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Mind Dance
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

entries.name: Hallucinatory Breath
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

motives_tactics: Collect shiny things, hunt, swoop
description: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.

name: Knight of the Realm

entries.name: Chevalier
entries.description: Passive: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they're next spotlighted.

entries.name: Heavily Armored
entries.description: Passive: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Cavalry Charge
entries.description: Action: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

entries.name: For the Realm!
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

motives_tactics: Run down, seek glory, show dominance
description: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.

name: Kelpie

entries.name: Captivating
entries.description: Passive: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.

entries.name: Heart's Desire
entries.description: Passive: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

entries.name: Hooves
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Shapeshifter
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

entries.name: Enchant
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

motives_tactics: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers
description: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.

name: Kraken

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Many Tentacles
entries.description: Passive: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Grapple and Drown
entries.description: Action: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

entries.name: Boiling Blast
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Consume, crush, drown, grapple
description: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.

name: Lamia

entries.name: Curved Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Constriction
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

entries.name: Life Leech
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

entries.name: Sleep Toxin
entries.description: Reaction: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

motives_tactics: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass
description: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.

name: Lamplight Beguiler

entries.name: Jaws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Doppel-Dangler
entries.description: Action: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

entries.name: Entice
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

entries.name: Gulp
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

motives_tactics: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk
description: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.

name: Landshark

entries.name: Burrowing
entries.description: Passive: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

entries.name: Thick-Skinned
entries.description: Passive: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

entries.name: Toothy Maw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Rending Chomp
entries.description: Reaction: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives_tactics: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey
description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.

name: Landshark Behemoth

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Deep Diver
entries.description: Passive: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

entries.name: Steel-Skinned
entries.description: Passive: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

entries.name: Toothy Maw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Forceful Eruption
entries.description: Action: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground
description: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.

name: Manticore

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Riddle Me This
entries.description: Passive: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

entries.name: Winged
entries.description: Passive: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

entries.name: Teeth & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+6) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Pouncing Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

entries.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

entries.name: Locking Jaws
entries.description: Reaction: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

motives_tactics: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick
description: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.

name: Masked Thief

entries.name: Backsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Quick Hands
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or from the target's inventory.

entries.name: Escape Plan
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

motives_tactics: Evade, hide, pilfer, profit
description: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.

name: Masque Muerte

entries.name: Libre
entries.description: Passive: The Masque Muerte can't be Restrained.

entries.name: Open-Handed Strike
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Heel Turn
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

entries.name: Spectral Suplex
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

entries.name: Unmasking Death
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Tag Team
entries.description: Reaction: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

motives_tactics: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground
description: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.

name: Master Assassin

entries.name: Won't See It Coming
entries.description: Passive: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're Hidden.

entries.name: Serrated Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Strike as One
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

entries.name: The Subtle Blade
entries.description: Reaction: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios
description: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.

name: Mechanorb

entries.name: Hive Mind
entries.description: Passive: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

entries.name: Adaptive Tactics
entries.description: Passive: Pool. When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

entries.name: Needle
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d10+1 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary
description: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.

name: Merchant

entries.name: Preferential Treatment
entries.description: Passive: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.

entries.name: The Runaround
entries.description: Passive: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+1 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit
description: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.

name: Merchant Baron

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Everyone Has a Price
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

entries.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4+1 Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron's will.

motives_tactics: Abusive power, gather resources, mobilize minions
description: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.

name: Minor Chaos Elemental

entries.name: Arcane Master
entries.description: Passive: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.

entries.name: Warp Blast
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 1d12+6 magic damage.

entries.name: Sickening Flux
entries.description: Action: Mark a HP to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until their next rest or they clear a HP.

entries.name: Remake Reality
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to transform the area within Very Close range into a different biome. All targets within this area take 2d6+3 direct magic damage.

entries.name: Magical Reflection
entries.description: Reaction: When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half of the damage they dealt.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Confound, destabilize, transmogrify
description: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.

name: Minor Demon

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Demon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: All Must Fall
entries.description: Passive: When a PC rolls a failure with Fear while within Close range of the Demon, they lose a Hope.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Hellfire
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to rain down hellfire within Far range. All targets within the area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d20+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Reaper
entries.description: Reaction: Before rolling damage for the Demon's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to the Demon's current number of marked HP.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Act erratically, corral targets, relish pain, torment
description: A crimson-hued creature from the Circles Below, consumed by rage against all mortals.

name: Minor Fire Elemental

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Elemental can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Elemental Blast
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d10+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Scorched Earth
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. The ground within Very Close range of that point immediately bursts into flames. All creatures within this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8 magic damage from the flames. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Explosion
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to erupt in a fiery explosion. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against take 1d8 magic damage and are knocked back to Far range.

entries.name: Consume Kindling
entries.description: Reaction: Three times per scene, when the Elemental moves on objects that are highly flammable, consume them to clear a HP or a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Encircle enemies, grow in size, intimidate, start fires
description: A living flame the size of a large bonfire.

name: Minor Treant

entries.name: Minion (5)
entries.description: Passive: The Treant is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Treant, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Cleaved Branch
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Minor Treants within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Crush, overwhelm, protect
description: An ambulatory sapling rising up to defend their forest.

name: Minotaur Wrecker

entries.name: Ramp Up
entries.description: Passive: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Charging Bull
