entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine their damage).

entries.name: Gore
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.

motives_tactics: Consume, gore, navigate, overpower, pursue
description: A massive bull-headed hybrid with a quick temper.

name: Monarch

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Execute Them!
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

entries.name: Crossguard
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

entries.name: Casus Bell
entries.description: Reaction: Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

motives_tactics: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy
description: The sovereign ruler of a nation, unearthed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.

name: Mortal Hunter

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Tear at Flesh
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Deathlock
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.

entries.name: Inevitable Death
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

entries.name: Rampage
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Devour, hunt, track
description: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a cruelly cut demeanor.

name: Mountain Troll

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Stolen Armor
entries.description: Passive: Countdown. When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged Mountain Troll").

entries.name: Skull Flail
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Flail Swipe
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Enraged Mountain Troll
entries.description:
Evolution: The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack:
  • Claw Swipe: Very Close | 1d10+3 phy
  • Double Swipe - Action: Spend a Fear to move up to Close range and make two standard attacks against a target within Melee range. If both attacks succeed, combine the damage, and the target loses a Hope.

motives_tactics: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp
description: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.

name: Night Children

entries.name: Horde (2d6+2)
entries.description: Passive: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 2 members of the horde (2/HP).

entries.name: Fangs & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Swell Ranks
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description: Reaction: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives_tactics: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow
description: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.

name: Octopus

entries.name: Beak
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6 physical damage.

entries.name: Grapple
entries.description: Action: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

entries.name: Squirt Ink
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming Vulnerable until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

motives_tactics: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape
description: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

name: Oak Treant

entries.name: Just a Tree
entries.description: Passive: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

entries.name: Branch
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Seed Barrage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Take Root
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

motives_tactics: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches
description: A sturdy animated old-growth tree.

name: Oracle of Doom

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Walls Closing In
entries.description: Passive: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Psychic Attack
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d8+9 magic damage.

entries.name: Pronounce Fate
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d10+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

entries.name: Summon Tormentors
entries.description: Action: Once per day, spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

entries.name: Ominous Knowledge
entries.description: Reaction: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

entries.name: Vengeful Fate
entries.description: Reaction: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside
description: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.

name: Outer Realms Abomination

entries.name: Chaotic Form
entries.description: Passive: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

entries.name: Disorienting Presence
entries.description: Passive: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Massive Pseudopod
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d6+13 magic damage.

entries.name: Reality Quake
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

entries.name: Fungal Form
entries.description: Reaction: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Confuse, demolish, devour, undermine
description: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.

name: Outer Realms Corruptor

entries.name: Will-Shattering Touch
entries.description: Passive: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

entries.name: Corroding Pseudopod
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d8+5 magic damage.

entries.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

motives_tactics: Confuse, distract, overwhelm
description: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.

name: Outer Realms Thrall

entries.name: Minion (13)
entries.description: Passive: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Claws and Teeth
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 11 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate
description: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.

name: Owl Witch

entries.name: Ill Omen
entries.description: Passive: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

entries.name: Witch Barrier
entries.description: Passive: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

entries.name: Razor Talons
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Voice Mimicry
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

entries.name: Nightmare Stare
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Afflict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Afflicted, the target can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Afflicted creature.

entries.name: Visions of a Violent End
entries.description: Reaction: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

motives_tactics: Consume essence, curse, predict death
description: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.

name: Pain Priest

entries.name: Torture Implements
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Walk Between Worlds
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

entries.name: Pleasure and Pain
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

motives_tactics: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires
description: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.

name: Panther

entries.name: Shadow Stalker
entries.description: Passive: While Hidden, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

entries.name: Teeth and Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Pouncing Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Climb trees, pounce, stalk
description: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.

name: Patchwork Zombie Hulk

entries.name: Destructive
entries.description: Passive: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

entries.name: Flailing Limbs
entries.description: Passive: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

entries.name: Too Many Arms
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d20 physical damage.

entries.name: Another for the Pile
entries.description: Action: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

entries.name: Tormented Screams
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Absorb corpses, flail, hunger, terrify
description: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.

name: Perfected Zombie

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: On successful attack, all PCs in Far range lose Hope and you gain Fear.

entries.name: Fearsome Presence
entries.description: Passive: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+15 physical damage.

entries.name: Perfect Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack all targets within Very Close range; on success, targets are Vulnerable until next rest.

entries.name: Skilled Opportunist
entries.description: Reaction: When another adversary deals damage to target within Very Close range of Zombie, spend a Fear to add Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

motives_tactics: Consume, hound, maim, terrify
description: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.

name: Petty Noble

entries.name: My Land, My Rules
entries.description: Passive: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have disadvantage.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Guards, Seize Them!
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4 Bladed Guards, who appear at Far range to enforce the Noble's will.

entries.name: Exile
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Noble proclaims that the target and their allies are exiled from the noble's territory. While exiled, the target and their allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

motives_tactics: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions
description: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.

name: Phantom

entries.name: Incorporeal
entries.description: Passive: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

entries.name: Fear Aura
entries.description: Passive: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Chill Touch
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Lingering Haunt
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (1d6). When the Phantom is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings
description: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.

name: Phoenix

entries.name: Purifying Aura
entries.description: Passive: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

entries.name: Fire Bolt
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 3d10+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Fireseed
entries.description: Reaction: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

entries.name: Resurrection
entries.description: Evolution: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

motives_tactics: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame
description: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.

name: Plesiosaurus

entries.name: Only a Rumor
entries.description: Passive: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Wall of Water
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

motives_tactics: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully
description: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

name: Pirate Captain

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.description: Passive: When the Captain marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Cutlass
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Reinforcements
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon a Pirate Raiders Horde, which appears at Far range.

entries.name: No Quarter
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target who has three or more Pirates within Melee range of them. The Captain leads the Pirates in hurling threats and promises of a watery grave. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target marks 1d4+1 Stress. On a success, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Command, make 'em walk the plank, plunder, raid
description: A charismatic sea dog with an impressive hat, eager to raid and plunder.

name: Pirate Raiders

entries.name: Horde (1d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.description: Passive: When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Cutlass
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Gang up, plunder, overwhelm
description: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.

name: Pirate Tough

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.description: Passive: When the Tough marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Massive Fists
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6 physical damage.

entries.name: Clear the Decks
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to move into Melee range of the target, dealing 3d4 physical damage and knocking the target back to Close range.

motives_tactics: Plunder, raid, smash, terrorize
description: A thickly muscled and tattooed pirate with melon-sized fists.

name: Poltergeist

entries.name: Specter
entries.description: Passive: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Thrown Object
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Possessor
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

entries.name: Ghost Storm
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d12+2 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_tactics: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room
description: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.

name: Rabble Mawb

entries.name: Horde (1d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Chomp
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Come Back Worse
entries.description: Reaction: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can spend a Fear to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

motives_tactics: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around
description: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.

name: Ravenous Mockery

entries.name: Gnashing Teeth
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Tongue Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

entries.name: Devour
entries.description: Action: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

entries.name: Never Just One
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

motives_tactics: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape
description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

name: Red Ooze

entries.name: Creeping Fire
entries.description: Passive: The Ooze can only move within Very Close range as their normal movement. They light any flammable object they touch on fire.

entries.name: Ooze Appendage
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Ignite
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 1d8 magic damage and is ignited until they're extinguished with a successful Finesse Roll (14). While ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they make an action roll.

entries.name: Split
entries.description: Reaction: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Red Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

motives_tactics: Camouflage, consume and multiply, ignite, start fires
description: A moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.

name: Tiny Red Ooze

entries.name: Ooze Appendage
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Burning
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature within Melee range deals damage to the Ooze, they take 1d6 direct magic damage.

motives_tactics: Blaze, camouflage
description: A small moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.

name: Redcap Biters

entries.name: Horde (1d4+2)
entries.description: Passive: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Ankle Weights
entries.description: Passive: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

entries.name: Gnash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+4 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls
description: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.

name: Redcap Breaker

entries.name: Wooden Mallet
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Backbreaker
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

entries.name: Kneecapper
entries.description: Reaction: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

motives_tactics: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly
description: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

name: Redcap Butcher

entries.name: Meat Cleaver
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Chop Happy
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Knife Thrower
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is Hidden, they make the attack with advantage.

motives_tactics: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble
description: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.

name: Redcap Candlemaker

entries.name: Hand of Glory
entries.description: Passive: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is Hidden.

entries.name: Torchbearer
entries.description: Passive: The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

entries.name: Burning Candlestick
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d10+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Dance in the Flames
entries.description: Action: Spend a token from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_tactics: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light
description: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.

name: Redcap Skinner

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Shallow Cuts
entries.description: Passive: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Razor
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice
description: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

name: Roc

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Bird of Prey
entries.description: Passive: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

entries.name: Beak & Talons
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Here Comes the Boom
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Crushing Grasp
entries.description: Reaction: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

entries.name: Nest Warden
entries.description:
Evolution: When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:
  • Wrathful—Passive: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.
  • Electrifying Aura—Passive: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

motives_tactics: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar
description: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.

name: Rotted Zombie

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround
description: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.

name: Royal Advisor

entries.name: Devastating Retort
entries.description: Passive: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Wand
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d4+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Bend Ears
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

entries.name: Scapegoat
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

motives_tactics: Curry favor, manufacture evidence, scheme
description: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.

name: Ruby Dragon

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Fearsome
entries.description: Passive: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Tooth & Claw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+6) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d8+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Melting Breath
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

entries.name: Volcanic Fissure
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

entries.name: Hot-Blooded
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

motives_tactics: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure
description: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.

name: Rugaru

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Child of Night
entries.description: Passive: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

entries.name: Bloodthirsty
entries.description: Passive: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

entries.name: Snapping Jaws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Howl at the Moon
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

entries.name: Flesh Ripper
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.

motives_tactics: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize
description: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.

name: Rust Eater

entries.name: Stifling Pheromones
entries.description: Passive: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Rust Touch
entries.description: Passive: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+4 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal
description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.

name: Sandwyrm

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

entries.name: Devour
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

entries.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
entries.description: Reaction: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

motives_tactics: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends
description: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.

name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast

entries.name: Waterlogged Weaponry
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Ka-Chomp
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 1d12 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

entries.name: Feeding Frenzy
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature marks HP, you can spend a Fear to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

entries.name: Scaly
entries.description: Reaction: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

motives_tactics: lamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline
description: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.

name: Scarecrow

entries.name: Made of Straw
entries.description: Passive: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

entries.name: Sickle
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Terror Vision
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

motives_tactics: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw
description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

name: Secret-Keeper

entries.name: Sigil-Laden Staff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d12 magic damage.

entries.name: Seize Your Moment
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

entries.name: Our Master's Will
entries.description: Reaction: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

entries.name: Summoning Ritual
entries.description: Reaction: Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

entries.name: Fallen Hounds
entries.description: Reaction: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

motives_tactics: Amass great power, plot, take command
description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.

name: Sellsword

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Charge, lacerate, overwhelm, profit
description: An armed mercenary testing their luck.

name: Severed Shadow

entries.name: Minion (12)
entries.description: Passive: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Strangle
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 10 magic damage.

entries.name: Shadow Grapple
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform
description: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.

name: Shambling Zombie

entries.name: Too Many to Handle
entries.description: Passive: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

entries.name: Horrifying
entries.description: Passive: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+1 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh
description: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend

entries.name: Fiendish Nature
entries.description: Passive: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

entries.name: Hidden Blade
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Impersonate
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Turn Invisible
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

entries.name: Backhanded Guidance
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die .

entries.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
entries.description: Reaction: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal
description: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Fiendish Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

entries.name: Mantis Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d12+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Demonic Rage
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

entries.name: Hall of Mirrors
entries.description: Action: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

entries.name: Flash Claw
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

entries.name: Mind Games
entries.description: Reaction: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

motives_tactics: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport
description: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.

name: Shark

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Rending Bite
entries.description: Passive: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

entries.name: Toothy Maw
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Blood in the Water
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

motives_tactics: Find the blood, isolate prey, target the weak
description: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.

name: Siren

entries.name: Captive Audience
entries.description: Passive: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target Entranced by their song, the attack deals 2d10+1 damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Distended Jaw Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Enchanting Song
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Entranced until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can mark a Stress to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While Entranced, a target can't act and is Vulnerable.

motives_tactics: Consume, lure prey, subdue with song
description: A half fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.

name: Skeleton Archer

entries.name: Opportunist
entries.description: Passive: When two or more adversaries are within Very Close range of a creature, all damage they each deal to that creature is doubled.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Deadly Shot
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 3d4+8 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Perforate distracted targets, play dead, steal skin
description: A fragile skeleton with a shortbow and arrows.

name: Skeleton Dredge

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Bone Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Dredges within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Fall apart, overwhelm, play dead, steal skin
description: A clattering pile of bones.

name: Skeleton Knight

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Rusty Greatsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Cut to the Bone
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take 1d8+2 physical damage and must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Dig Two Graves
entries.description: Reaction: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d8+4 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.

motives_tactics: Cut down the living, steal skin, wreak havoc
description: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.

name: Skeleton Warrior

entries.name: Only Bones
entries.description: Passive: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

entries.name: Sword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Reform
entries.description: Reaction: When the Warrior is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

motives_tactics: Feign death, gang up, steal skin
description: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.

name: Spectral Archer

entries.name: Ghost
entries.description: Passive: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Pick Your Target
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Move through solid objects, stay out of the fray, rehash old battles
description: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is Vulnerable.

name: Spectral Captain

entries.name: Ghost
entries.description: Passive: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Longbow
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Unending Battle
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

entries.name: Hold Fast
entries.description: Reaction: When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Move through solid objects, rally troops, rehash old battles
description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

name: Spectral Guardian

entries.name: Ghost
entries.description: Passive: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Grave Blade
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Move through solid objects, protect treasure, rehash old battles
description: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.

name: Spellblade

entries.name: Arcane Steel
entries.description: Passive: Damage dealt by the Spellblade's standard attack is considered both physical and magic.

entries.name: Empowered Longsword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+4 phy/mag damage.

entries.name: Suppressing Blast
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress and target a group within Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d8+2 magic damage. You gain a Fear for each target who marked HP from this attack.

entries.name: Move as Unit
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight up to five allies within Far range.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Spellblade makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Blast, command, endure
description: A mercenary combining swordplay and magic to deadly effect.

name: Sprite

entries.name: Minion (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Needle-Sharp Arrows
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 5 physical damage.

entries.name: Art of Invisibility
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

entries.name: Dream Petal Poison
entries.description: Action: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

motives_tactics: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness
description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.

name: Spy

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Gathering Secrets
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

entries.name: Fly on the Wall
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

motives_tactics: Cut and run, disguise appearance, eavesdrop
description: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.

name: Soul-Shattered Mage

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Wormwood Staff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 1d12 magic damage.

entries.name: Broken Magic
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to roll a d6. The Mage uses the corresponding move:
  • 1–2: Dimension Rift. Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes 2d6 direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.
  • 3–4: Time Dilation. Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is Slowed until they roll with Hope. While Slowed, a target is Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they move.
  • 5–6: Discordant Visions. Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take 2d8 direct magic damage.

entries.name: Feel My Pain
entries.description: Reaction: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

motives_tactics: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control
description: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.

name: Spellbound Armor

entries.name: Tireless
entries.description: Passive: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

entries.name: Zweihander
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d10+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
entries.description: Reaction: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

motives_tactics: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently
description: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.

name: Stag Knight

entries.name: From Above
entries.description: Passive: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Bramble Sword
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Blade of the Forest
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target's Major threshold.

entries.name: Thorny Armor
entries.description: Reaction: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

motives_tactics: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome
description: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.

name: Stone Titan

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Skillful Strike
entries.description: Passive: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can mark a Stress and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

entries.name: Sunlight Sickness
entries.description: Passive: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

entries.name: Stone Hammer
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d6+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Hammer Smash
entries.description: Action: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives_tactics: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude
description: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.

name: Stonewraith

entries.name: Stonestrider
entries.description: Passive: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are Hidden and immune to all damage.

entries.name: Bite and Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Rocky Ambush
entries.description: Action: While Hidden, mark a Stress to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained.

entries.name: Avalanche Roar
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d10 physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Defend territory, isolate prey, stalk
description: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.

name: Storm Titan

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Passive: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d20+10 magic damage.

entries.name: Ball Lightning
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

entries.name: Storm Bringer
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Thunderclap
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

motives_tactics: Erupt violently, wait, watch
description: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.

name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix

entries.name: Relentless (4)
entries.description: Passive: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Wing Strike
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Elemental Archon
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect:
  1. Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam's path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage.
  2. Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated.
  3. Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets.
  4. Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape.

entries.name: Alpha to Omega
entries.description:
Evolution: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You you can spend a Fear for each Hope lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form:
  • Forsaken—Action: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.
  • Armageddon—Reaction: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a death move.

motives_tactics: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being
description: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.

name: Swarm of Rats

entries.name: Horde (1d4+1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 1 member of the horde (1/HP).

entries.name: In Your Face
entries.description: Passive: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

motives_tactics: Consume, obscure, swarm
description: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.

name: Sylvan Soldier

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: Passive: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

entries.name: Scythe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Forest Control
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Blend In
entries.description: Reaction: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Hidden until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

motives_tactics: Ambush, hide, overwhelm, protect, trail
description: A faerie warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.

name: Tangle Bramble

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Bramble is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Tangle Bramble, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Thorns
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Tangle Brambles within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

entries.name: Drain and Multiply
entries.description: Reaction: When an attack from the Bramble causes a target to mark HP and there are three or more Tangle Bramble Minions within Close range, you can combine the Minions into a Tangle Bramble Swarm Horde. The Horde's HP is equal to the number of Minions combined.

motives_tactics: Consume, drain, entangle
description: An animate, blood-drinking tumbleweed.

name: Tangle Bramble Swarm

entries.name: Horde (1d4+2)
entries.description: Passive: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Thorns
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Crush
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+8 direct physical damage to a target with 3 or more bramble tokens.

entries.name: Encumber
entries.description: Reaction: When the Swarm succeeds on an attack, give the target a bramble token. If a target has any bramble tokens, they are Restrained. If a target has 3 or more bramble tokens, they are also Vulnerable. All bramble tokens can be removed by succeeding on a Finesse Roll (12 + the number of bramble tokens) or dealing Major or greater damage to the Swarm. If bramble tokens are removed from a target using a Finesse Roll, a number of Tangle Bramble Minions spawn within Melee range equal to the number of tokens removed.

motives_tactics: Digest, entangle, immobilize
description: A cluster of animated, blood-drinking tumbleweeds, each the size of a large gourd.

name: Temporal Enforcer

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Time Looper
entries.description: Passive: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

entries.name: Adamantine Hammer
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 40 direct physical damage.

entries.name: Move Between Moments
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

entries.name: Instant Rewind
entries.description: Reaction: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

entries.name: Invert Polarity
entries.description: Reaction: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can't be used to alter a critical success.

motives_tactics: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity
description: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.

name: Treant Sapling

entries.name: Minion (6)
entries.description: Passive: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Branches
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 8 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround
description: A small, sentient tree sapling.

name: Triceratops

entries.name: Leathery Hide
entries.description: Passive: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

entries.name: Horns
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Tail Swipe
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Bull Rush
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

motives_tactics: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole
description: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

name: Tyrannosaurus

entries.name: Mighty Jaws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

entries.name: Stomp
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

entries.name: Crushing Bite
entries.description: Reaction: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

motives_tactics: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around
description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

name: Unicorn

entries.name: Celestial Lance
entries.description: Passive: The Unicorn's standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

entries.name: Hoof & Horn
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d10+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries.description: Action: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally's HP.

entries.name: Protective Aura
