entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

motives_tactics: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent
description: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.

name: Urco

entries.name: Fearmonger
entries.description: Passive: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Terror-Fueled
entries.description: Passive: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

entries.name: Black Fang
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Fear Eater
entries.description: Action: Spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of HP.

entries.name: Baleful Gaze
entries.description: Reaction: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can spend a Fear to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a −1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

motives_tactics: Feed, frighten, hunt
description: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

name: Valdenhax

entries.name: Giant Stone Pestle
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: To Me, My Pretties
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You you can spend a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

entries.name: Shadow Strangler
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

entries.name: Corpse Whisperer
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

entries.name: Vexing Word
entries.description: Reaction: After a PC makes a roll, you can mark a Stress to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

motives_tactics: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers
description: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.

name: Vampire

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8 physical damage.

entries.name: Draining Bite
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

entries.name: Mistform
entries.description: Reaction: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

motives_tactics: Bite, charm, deceive, feed, intimidate
description: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.

name: Vampire Bat Swarm

entries.name: Horde (2d6)
entries.description: Passive: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 5 members of the horde (5/HP).

entries.name: Blinding Multitude
entries.description: Passive: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

entries.name: Fange
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Bloodsucker
entries.description: Reaction: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

motives_tactics: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease
description: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.

name: Vampire Lord

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Midnight Heart
entries.description: Passive: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it's destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

entries.name: Terrifying
entries.description: Passive: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+5) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Unleash Hellfire
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

entries.name: Resurgence
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

entries.name: Melt into Shadow
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

entries.name: Hellwing
entries.description:
Evolution: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the "On Crimson Wings" and "Blood Bath" features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack:
  • Claws: Close | 3d12+6 phy
  • On Crimson Wings—Passive: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.
  • Blood Bath—Reaction: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

motives_tactics: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power
description: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.

name: Vault Guardian Gaoler

entries.name: Blocking Shield
entries.description: Passive: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

entries.name: Body Bash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d6+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Lock Up
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

motives_tactics: Carry away, entrap, protect, pummel
description: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.

name: Vault Guardian Sentinel

entries.name: Kinetic Slam
entries.description: Passive: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

entries.name: Charged Mace
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d12+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Box In
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

entries.name: Mana Bolt
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 8d20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect
description: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.

name: Vault Guardian Turret

entries.name: Slow Firing
entries.description: Passive: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

entries.name: Magitech Cannon
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d10+3 magic damage.

entries.name: Mark Target
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

entries.name: Concentrate Fire
entries.description: Reaction: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

entries.name: Detonation
entries.description: Reaction: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_tactics: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect
description: A massive hulking turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston-driven mechanical legs.

name: Viper

entries.name: Minion (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Venomous
entries.description: Passive: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1 physical damage.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Lie in wait, slither, strike
description: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.

name: Viscera Sucker

entries.name: Join or Die
entries.description: Passive: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

entries.name: Long Nails
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d6+7 physical damage.

entries.name: Entangling Entrails
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

entries.name: Lifesuck
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

motives_tactics: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half
description: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight.

entries.name: Flying
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains +3 Difficulty.

entries.name: Obsidian Scales
entries.description: Passive: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

entries.name: Obsidian Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d10+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Avalanche Tail
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make attack against all targets within Close range. Success: 4d6+4 physical damage, knocked to Far range and Vulnerable until next roll with Hope.

entries.name: Dive-Bomb
entries.description: Action: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical, mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

entries.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
entries.description: Reaction: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate
description: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Cracked Scales
entries.description: Passive: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Lava-Coated Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+9) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Shattering Might
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, target takes 4d8+14 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

entries.name: Eruption
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling area within Very Close range with lava. All targets must make Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. The area remains lava (6 HP damage on entry or action).

entries.name: Volcanic Breath
entries.description: Reaction: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll d10. On 8+, erupt lava in Very Close range: Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until clearing a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Lava Splash
entries.description: Reaction: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from attack within Very Close, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals 2d10+4 direct physical damage to attacker.

entries.name: Ashen Vengeance (Phase Change)
entries.description: Reaction: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

motives_tactics: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel invaders, respawn
description: Engaged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant

entries.name: Relentless (4)
entries.description: Passive: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Cornered
entries.description: Passive: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

entries.name: Injured Wings
entries.description: Passive: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

entries.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries.description: Passive: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

entries.name: Claws and Teeth
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+10) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+15 physical damage.

entries.name: Desperate Rampage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Ashen Cloud
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to smash the ground beneath an adversary within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

entries.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
entries.description: Action: Countdown (1d12). Spend a Fear to activate it. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it reaches 0, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

motives_tactics: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed
description: A legendary, lava-hardened dragon. No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so.

name: War Wizard

entries.name: Battle Teleport
entries.description: Passive: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Refresh Warding Sphere
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard's Warding Sphere reaction.

entries.name: Eruption
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't moved.

entries.name: Arcane Artillery
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Warding Sphere
entries.description: Reaction: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can't be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their Refresh Warding Sphere action.

motives_tactics: Develop new spells, seek power, conquer
description: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.

name: Water Mother

entries.name: Segmented
entries.description: Passive: The Water Mother's body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 4d10+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Eat the World
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

entries.name: Constrict
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

entries.name: Venom Surge
entries.description: Reaction: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

motives_tactics: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water
description: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.

name: Waxwork Creation

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: No Vital Organs
entries.description: Passive: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

entries.name: Firsts
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d20 physical damage.

entries.name: Wax Ball
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

entries.name: Splutch!
entries.description: Reaction: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

entries.name: Smothering Grapple
entries.description: Reaction: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation's wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

motives_tactics: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother
description: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.

name: Weaponmaster

entries.name: Claymore
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Goading Strike
entries.description: Action: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, mark a Stress to Taunt the target until their next successful attack. The next time the Taunted target attacks, they have disadvantage against targets other than the Weaponmaster.

entries.name: Adrenaline Burst
entries.description: Action: Once per scene, spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Weaponmaster makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Act first, aim for the weakest, intimidate
description: A master-at-arms wielding a sword twice their size.

name: Whisper Wraith

entries.name: Greater Specter
entries.description: Passive: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

entries.name: Spooky
entries.description: Passive: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Shadow Touch
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+4) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+4 magic damage.

entries.name: Nightmare Shroud
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

motives_tactics: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads
description: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisps

entries.name: Horde (1d4−1)
entries.description: Passive: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4−1 magic damage instead. Each HP stands for 8 members of the horde (8/HP).

entries.name: Kaleidoscopic
entries.description: Passive: The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are Vulnerable.

entries.name: Flash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 1d4+2 magic damage.

entries.name: Fascinating
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

motives_tactics: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray
description: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.

name: Wyrmfiend

entries.name: Minion (13)
entries.description: Passive: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

entries.name: Weapons from the Hoard
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+3) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 11 physical damage.

entries.name: Venomous Bite
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Group Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_tactics: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm
description: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.

name: Wyrmlings

entries.name: Horde (2d6+5)
entries.description: Passive: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Tiny Jaws & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d6+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Ravenous
entries.description: Reaction: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description: Reaction: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

motives_tactics: Consume, shred, swarm
description: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.

name: Wyvern

entries.name: Teeth & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

entries.name: Terrifying Shriek
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

entries.name: Clutch
entries.description: Reaction: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

motives_tactics: a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air
description: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.

name: Yufo

entries.name: Telepathic
entries.description: Passive: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

entries.name: Psychic Strongbox
entries.description: Passive: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

entries.name: Tentacle Leash
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−3) against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Glitch Wave
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

entries.name: Temporal Corrosion
entries.description: Reaction: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

motives_tactics: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows
description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.

name: Young Dryad

entries.name: Scythe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+0) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Voice of the Forest
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

entries.name: Thorny Cage
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they're freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Command, nurture, prune the unwelcome
description: An imperious tree-person leading their forest's defenses.

name: Young Fire Dragon

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Intimidating
entries.description: Passive: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

entries.name: Bite & Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Flame Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

entries.name: Eruption
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You you can spend a Fear for each PC who fails.

entries.name: Blazing Scales
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Slash and Burn
entries.description: Reaction: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you you can spend a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

motives_tactics: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take
description: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.

name: Young Ice Dragon

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Rend and Crush
entries.description: Passive: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

entries.name: No Hope
entries.description: Passive: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

entries.name: Bite and Claws
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+7) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d10 physical damage.

entries.name: Blizzard Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whirlwind in an area within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

entries.name: Avalanche
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Frozen Scales
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_tactics: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul
description: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.

name: Xero the Castle Killer

entries.name: Relentless (X)
entries.description: Passive: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

entries.name: Collateral Damage
entries.description: Passive: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

entries.name: Tail Swipe
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+8) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d12+6 physical damage.

entries.name: Gigaton Stomp
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

entries.name: Power Slide
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

entries.name: Radioactive Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Action: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

motives_tactics: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements
description: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.

name: Zombie Legion

entries.name: Horde (2d6+5)
entries.description: Passive: When Legion has half or more HP marked, standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 3 members of the horde (3/HP).

entries.name: Unyielding
entries.description: Passive: Legion has resistance to physical damage.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight.

entries.name: Undead Hands
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (+2) against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 4d6+10 physical damage.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description: Reaction: When Legion takes Minor damage from attack within Melee, mark a Stress to make standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

motives_tactics: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround
description: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.

name: Zombie Pack

entries.name: Horde (1d4+2)
entries.description: Passive: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead. Each HP stands for 2 members of the horde (2/HP).

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Standard Attack: Make an attack (−1) against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description: Reaction: When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives_tactics: Consume flesh, hunger, maul
description: A group of shambling corpses instinctively moving together.
